evaluator: W3-014 worker (no vendor accounts, no paid plans, no vendor outreach)

method.tools: z-ai web_search (query -> official URLs) + page_reader (content extraction of official pages); captures committed under docs/competitors/captures/ (search-*.json, page-*.json raw, text-*.txt extracted text)
method.class_assignment: A=authorized account/sandbox (none available; 0 produced). B=authentic official interactive demo/public UI observed via content extraction (no login, no interaction, no transaction; limitation always recorded). C=official documentation page READ by evaluator (page capture in repo; nav-level or marketing-level depth recorded as limitation). D=unverified/not accessible (JS-walled, stub, tracker junk, timeout) — official URLs recorded as pointers; D supports NO claim including superiority.

status_vocabulary.offered: capability present per captured evidence (coverage field may say partial)
status_vocabulary.not_accessible: evaluator blocked (JS wall, login wall, site down) — NOT proof the competitor lacks the capability
status_vocabulary.not_applicable: outside this incumbent's product category per task-pack applicability guidance

honesty_rules: no fabricated UI actions, features, prices, latency, market share or position
no timing claims (no reproducible comparable-condition method exists)
workflow-level tables only; no aggregate winner
UNiCOM column cites contract-level surfaces only; rendered-browser evidence belongs to W1-010's lane
V3 numbers are synthetic simulation estimates, labelled as such
